units.source_text: 他们的一致意见是：必须让金阁寺和银阁寺捐献更多的效。

en.t: They were unanimous in their view: Kinkakuji and Ginkakuji had to be made to contribute more.

units.source_text: 尽管报阁只有金阁的一半收入，也是一笔巨大的金额啊。

en.t: Even though the Silver Pavilion had only half the income of the Golden Pavilion, it was still an enormous sum.

units.source_text: 举例来说，金阁年收人估计在500万元以上，寺庙的生活是禅家之常，

en.t: For example, the Golden Pavilion's annual income was estimated at more than five million yen, while temple life followed the ordinary ways of a Zen household,

units.source_text: 加上水电及，一年费用充其量是20多万元。

en.t: and even including water, electricity, and other expenses, the yearly cost came to at most a little over two hundred thousand yen.

units.source_text: 余下的钱是怎样处理的？

en.t: How was the remaining money being handled?

units.source_text: 一提起这件事，大家都相继发言了。

en.t: Once this matter was brought up, everyone began speaking one after another.

units.source_text: 有人说寺庙让小和尚吃冷饭，

en.t: Someone said the temple made the young monks eat cold leftovers,

units.source_text: 老和尚自己却每晚到抵园去寻欢作乐。

en.t: while the old monk himself went off every night to Gion to amuse himself.

units.source_text: 寺庙的收入也不用上税，是同享受治外法权一样。

en.t: Temple income was not taxed either, which was just like enjoying extraterritorial privileges.

units.source_text: 像这种地方，就必须无情地要求他们捐献。

en.t: Places like that had to be pressed mercilessly to make contributions.
